abstract: Maintains bacterial spore challenge inactivation performance records
system_message:
You are the Sterilization cycle engineer (SCE), responsible for maintaining bacterial spore challenge inactivation performance records and documenting reagent injection dosing parameters across decontamination protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains bacterial spore challenge inactivation performance records（CYCTIME）
information_points.content:
SCE-CYCTIME-PFI：For Aerosolized peracetic acid misting, tested on worst-case chamber penetration test coupons with the measurement start reference measured from plateau concentration attainment, the bacterial spore challenge kill time is 30 min.
SCE-CYCTIME-MAA：For Vaporized hydrogen peroxide gaseous fumigation, with the measurement start reference measured from plateau concentration attainment across worst-case chamber penetration test coupons, the bacterial spore challenge kill time is 45 min.
SCE-CYCTIME-ESE：For Vaporized hydrogen peroxide gaseous fumigation, under the measurement start reference measured from initial fumigant injection start across worst-case chamber penetration test coupons, the bacterial spore challenge kill time is 60 min.
SCE-CYCTIME-0T4：For Chlorine dioxide dry gas sterilization, evaluating worst-case chamber penetration test coupons with the measurement start reference measured from plateau concentration attainment, the bacterial spore challenge kill time is 30 min.

information_points.title: Reagent injection dosing（INJECT）
information_points.content:
SCE-INJECT-SWX：For Chlorine dioxide dry gas sterilization, the vaporizer injection flow rate measured at the fumigant vaporizer injection nozzles is 20 g/min during the gas generation phase.
SCE-INJECT-FJG：For Aerosolized peracetic acid misting, the vaporizer injection flow rate across the fumigant vaporizer injection nozzles is 25 g/min during the gas generation phase.
SCE-INJECT-DOD：For Vaporized hydrogen peroxide gaseous fumigation, the vaporizer injection flow rate at the fumigant vaporizer injection nozzles is 15 g/min during the gas generation phase.
